body_html:
#edu307 "I found it interesting how the author referred to the education practices African American males are associated as a “path to humiliation” (Tatum, 3). The “disabling” texts that these students are encountering in schools do not meet the characteristics that will enable these students to set themselves on a positive life path."

Wow such a powerful quote. Drills home every time a student share this. Never the path to #literacies and I fear with the state of the web we are doing it all over
